data.name: FEAR BOUNDS: Amelia story
data.detailed_description:
Fear Bounds. A psychological horror about family secrets and a reality shaped by your fear.

1991. An old manor surrounded by endless cornfields. Amelia has lost everything. Her only solace is the attic, filled with generations of forgotten clutter. But the acute pain of loss and despair opens up something else—doors to realities formed by her deepest phobias.

Fear Bounds is a story about the blurred lines between reality and the subconscious, and how generational trauma manifests as physical nightmares. With every step into the world of fear, Amelia moves closer to the truth about her family, whose secrets have been hidden beneath the American soil for decades.

Confront the Worlds that Exist Only in Your Mind:

  • Atmospheric Horror. Travel through worlds born of phobias: from the absolute darkness of Arachnophobia, to the chilling depths of Thalassophobia, and the dizzying heights of Acrophobia.

  • Cinematic Tension. Developed with Unreal Engine 5 and dynamic lighting, where every frame is designed to create emotional stress. The visual aesthetic blends a child's perception of terror with realistic gruesomeness.

  • Survival and Exploration. The chill running down your spine is accompanied by the need to fight. Use your flashlight in the darkness to deter threats, or cold weapons if you choose an aggressive path. Hide in the shadows from unwanted eyes and find new items. Each world yields unique artifacts that will allow you to unlock the manor and its secrets.

  • Your Choice Determines the Ending. We can conquer our fears, or we can drown in them. Your decisions while unraveling the mystery's story have a direct consequence for the finale.

Are you ready to discover what hides behind your greatest fear?

Please add the game to your Wishlist so we can confidently move forward towards release.

data.short_description: Through phobias to the truth. Embark on the chilling journey of the girl, Amelia. Monsters and horrors born of a child's imagination rise up, revealing the deepest secrets of her family's past. Fight or flee, hide or jump! Learn, solve puzzles, and explore these terrifying, twisted worlds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Performance quality settings in 30 at 720p. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2080 or AMD Radeon™ RX 6800XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on Performance settings in 60 FPS or Quality settings in 30 FPS at FullHD (or 4k using DLSS or similar technology). SSD required.
